games.name: 💥 BUCKSHOT
games.desc:
Loaded shotgun. Mixed shells. Your move.

Take turns with a shotgun loaded with lives and blanks. Shoot your rival, or risk a blank to keep the turn. Count every shell that's spent, play the odds, and lie to their face.

🔫 Duels and brawls
Tense 1v1 duels or 4-player tables where nobody trusts anybody.

🎒 Items
Peek shells, rack one out, handcuff rivals, heal, invert a shell, or steal what they were saving. Every item flips the round.

🏆 Ranked
Climb from placements to the top of the ladder. Seasonal ranks, exclusive titles, and a global top 100.

🎨 Skins and titles
Win cash, open cases, unbox skins from Common to Contraband and beyond. Rare drops roll a TrakStat module that counts your kills. Collect animated titles, level up, clear daily quests.

💱 Trading
Trade skins and titles with anyone, or hit the Trading Hub to hunt for limiteds. Some guns only exist in the double digits.

👍 Like the game and join our group for a free Deluxe Case + cash.

games.name: The Battle Bricks
games.desc:
[UPDATE - CHAPTER 5]: Undead Cation, a brand new challenging chapter along with overhauls and quality of life changes for the majority of the game.

The Battle Bricks is a single-player tower defense styled game where you send units to defeat enemy bases to progress through stages! Although, the enemies will send units to attack back! Discover the seemingly countless amount of units along the way with varying purposes and upgrade them enough to see their alternative forms! Each stage and chapter will make you face new enemies, bases, bosses, or even how stages are handled to challenge your skills and strategies. A linear game that you can pick up from any time!

And... there's something to uncover if you ever want to have a feeling that's difficult to describe ...?

[NOTE]: Incomplete, still on-going! The game-play is inspired from The Battle Cats, although has its own spin on it.
